task.title: Inspect and Compare Commits
task.shortdesc: Review a single commit, compare a range of revisions, or compare your working copy against an earlier one.

step.cmd:
Inspect or compare commits in the
view.

choices.choice: Select one commit to see its (bottom-left pane) and the it changed (bottom-right pane).
Select two or more commits (use Ctrl or Shift) to see the differences across that range.

Select the
entry together with a revision to compare your working copy against that revision. This is available only when the working copy has uncommitted changes.

info.p: Select any single commit to end a revision comparison.

step.cmd: In the pane, right-click a file to open, compare, or reset a specific version.
